text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, while walking down the street, I spotted
Taiki Shuttle and Nishino Flower in a kitchen studio.
choice_data_list: A character bento class, huh... Wow, looks fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san! You are welcome to observe!
Please watch a lot and eat a lot!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Today I am helping out Flower.
Look, it's just getting started!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When making the face parts, you cut the nori seaweed
and paste it on.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Using thread-cutting scissors makes delicate work much
easier. If it's still too difficult, try drawing a template
on baking paper first!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
How is that? She is being such a splendid teacher
in front of so many people! I can't afford to
lose to her either!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hup, hup, hup!
This is an authentic American-style
hamburg steak!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Taiki-senpai, ...!
Now, let's roll this mixture into bite-sized balls
and grill them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Nishino Flower and Taiki Shuttle's marvelous
combination, the character bento workshop proceeded in high spirits, but—

text_block_list.name: Young Father
text_block_list.text: —U-Um, like... like this?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, watch your fingers, that's dangerous.
When holding down food, do it like this—
make a kitty cat paw!

text_block_list.name: Young Father
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry... I had no idea using a knife was this tough...
I really wanted to make a character bento for my son,
but I wonder if I can really do it...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! No one is good at it right from the start,
and that's exactly why we're here to help.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Can't use a kitchen knife?
Problem nothing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If you don't have the skill, push through with power!
Take fried chicken, for example! Just deep-fry the whole meat cutlet!
Now, season it and knead it, knead it!

text_block_list.name: Young Father
text_block_list.text: Eh, l-like this?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Octopus wieners? Hmm,
dreams and wieners are best when they're big!
Go with a huge frankfurter!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Tear the vegetables apart with your bare hands!
Don't worry even if you can't cut them neatly!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
WOW, did your onigiri fall apart?
When that happens, just dock everything together!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Taiki-senpai is a great cook, and above all,
what's most important when making a bento is—

text_block_list.name: Young Father
text_block_list.text:
...H-Hey, Taiki-san, is this really going to be alright?
It feels like we're straying pretty far from a character bento...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No! No, no, Dad! Smile, smi~le!!

text_block_list.name: Young Father
text_block_list.text: Huh? Smile...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My papa back home always said:
'Cooking is Love & Power!
And Smile!'

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If the person making it isn't having fun,
you can never make delicious food!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So please pour in lots of love.
Picture your child's happy face, and give a big smile!

text_block_list.name: Young Father
text_block_list.text:
You're right—alright! Just you wait, son,
Daddy's gonna make the greatest character bento ever!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —It is finished, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Young Father
text_block_list.text: Yeah, we made it, huh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...It's amazing. An onigiri body, frankfurter horns,
fried chicken fins, and vegetables portraying a stormy sea. Could this be...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
YES! The giant monster character bento
is complete! It's gorgeous!
choice_data_list: It's bursting right out of the lunchbox, though...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Don't mind the small details!
What matters most is that you made it yourself, Dad!

text_block_list.name: Young Father
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you're right.
Thank you, Taiki-san!
Son, your dad did it!
choice_data_list: Your kid's going to love this!
Your kid's going to love this!

text_block_list.name: Young Father
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, you're right.
Thank you, Taiki-san!
Son, your dad did it!
choice_data_list: Your kid's going to love this!
Your kid's going to love this!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Non, non, I was just a helper.
The MVP is you, Dad!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now both father and son will be happy!
Let's crown this grand finale!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
YES!
Your child will definitely give you a big smile!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Every single bite is packed with a father's love,
a veritable food rampage!
